identification: Two red art glass footed bowls, 1950s-60s Italian/Murano style. Bowl 1: deep red bowl with quilted diamond (moulded) texture, clear scalloped applied rim, on a ribbed foot of clear glass with gold aventurine (gold fleck) inclusions, the 'Venetian' one. Bowl 2: smaller wavy ruffled red bowl on a clear amber-tinted disc foot with pontil, probably Murano or a similar Italian/other maker. No maker marks seen; attribution not possible beyond Murano-style.

viewing_check: Estimate $40-80, no bid yet. Comparable red/gold Murano bowls sell A$35-100 on eBay AU (2024-2025), mostly Terapeak sales, so the pair is probably worth about $60-120 combined at best. Check the foot of bowl 2 for a chip, the rim of bowl 1 (fine scalloped rim chips easily), whether either has a Murano label or Seguso/Barovier attribution, and fleck density in the foot. Price age 1-2.5 years, steady.
